---
title: "system-ui in table styling (quarto-cli #11683)"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      # system-ui and the other stack entries aren't Typst families; the
      # keywords must be resolved or dropped, never emitted.
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '#set text\(font: \("[^"]+"'
        -
          - '"system-ui"'
          - '"sans-serif"'
---

::: {style='font-family: system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji"'}

| Col | Num |
|-----|-----|
| abc | 123 |

:::
